meta.title: Compression tiers & toolbox
meta.description:
Five automatic compaction tiers — gentle / light / standard / aggressive / max: picking one writes thresholdRatio and retainRatio into every mounted preset compacting engine, no restart needed; the choice lives in <DSH home>/compression-tiers/settings.json, every tier keeps automatic pressure compaction, and /compact still works by hand.

Four agent tools: compression_tiers reads or changes the tier (optional per-route headroom overrides); compression_context reports live occupancy and the room left; compression_compact queues one proactive compaction that runs after the turn and resumes by itself; github_push publishes the current work (network probe, secret scan, 60-second deadline, a failure family plus whatever is still local).

Global rules: the page edits <DSH home>/AGENTS.md atomically, the system prompt carries the newest 2,000-character clip, and no agent tool can rewrite that file.

Components: four managed builds — GitHub CLI 2.76.2, git 2.56.1, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python 3.11.18. PATH detection, a managed download with resume (retries a dropped link, probes before swapping the tree in, rolls back on failure, reuses a finished archive), managed copies first on this process PATH, one migratable download root for all four, and gh device-code sign-in beside them.

Session repository: a selector under the session title binds the session to one writable repository, and github_push targets it by default (it only changes the push target, never clones or edits the workspace).

Limits: the tiers assume 256k-token windows or more, only preset-isolated engines are updated, and another plugin managing the same engines will fight over the policy.
